text:
Evan (New Hire): Hey team, quick onboarding calendar oddity. My calendar shows Orientation at 09:00 but when I open the event on my phone the Zoom link is missing and all I see is a passcode field. Timezone reads PST even though I'm in IST. Is this the APAC session?

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Evan! :wave: There are separate recurrences for NA and APAC. Can you paste the event ID from the invite details? Also are you seeing this in Google Calendar app or iOS/Android native calendar?

Evan (New Hire): Event ID is 991234. I'm on Android using the Google Calendar app. The event location says "Zoom" but no clickable URL.

Ravi - IT: Hi Evan  passcode-only appearance usually means the meeting provider metadata didn't include a direct link for the calendar surface. Quick checks: open the event in Google Calendar web -> More actions -> View original. Look for a `https://redwood.zoom.us/j/` line. If not present, reply here and I will patch the event description with the join URL.

Evan (New Hire): View original shows "Join Zoom Meeting" line but no URL. Tried removing and re-adding the shared people-ops calendar, no change.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks, Ravi can you attach the APAC join link to 991234? Also, we'll update the invite title to include "(APAC 09:00 IST)" so the timezone is explicit.

calendar-bot: Event 991234 updated by Ravi - IT (description modified).

Ravi - IT: Done  I added the join URL and hid the redundant passcode field so the mobile app shows the link. Join: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/1122334455

Evan (New Hire): Link visible now, thanks! One more question: if I can't attend live, where will the recording be posted? I use Drive but I saw Confluence mentioned in the handbook.

Maya (People Ops): Recordings upload to our onboarding S3 bucket and we mirror the links on the New Hires Confluence page under "Orientation Recordings". We post the Confluence link in #new-hires within 24 hours after the session. If you prefer Drive, DM me and I'll share a Drive mirror for quick download.

Sam (Onboarding Buddy): Evan, I'm on the same APAC session and I take short notes. If you miss it, ping me and I can send a 15-30 min catch-up and the notes. Welcome! :tada:

Evan (New Hire): Appreciate it, thanks everyone. Also +1 for adding timezone to the event title  that helped clarify which recurrence I was on.

Maya (People Ops): Noted  we'll add a DST/caching note on Confluence too so future hires don't get tripped up by cached organizer timezones. Welcome to Redwood! :sparkles:
